limitations: Five alternating pairs on one Apple M4; no confidence interval
Unprofiled CoreMark measures flat integer CPU/device work, not Windows/Rosetta speed
Profiled short intervals explain coverage; their timings are not performance scores
Existing Win95 images; no fresh installer/Office fixture created
Rosetta fault observation is not native Intel-hardware conformance proof

faultReference.scope: Rosetta macOS signal exception-state fields for load, store and INC on a PROT_NONE mapping; not native Intel hardware
